findings.reason: the done-when is the measure the node is closed on, so leaving project out of its table and bar lets the central per-project requirement the change added go unverified.
findings.text: the done-when's table is keyed "requirement, bucket, rows, passed, median attempts, median review total" and the bar at line 257 says a signal "separates a requirement", but the deliverable at line 248 now states every count is reported "per project, role, spec level and requirement", that a signal "is named as separating only within a project", and that a table pooled across projects "decides no verdict"; a node can satisfy the done-when with one pooled table per signal while violating the deliverable, and the control's own bar (line 262, "clears the bar at a requirement") is likewise computed without the project cut
